## What these figures mean

As for vols. 1–3 and 6: see `ocr/03/articles-report.md` for how articles are located, and
`ocr/06/articles-report.md` for `folded`. Every row is `status: "ocr"`. Nothing is proofread.

## Vol. 18 specifics

- Located 92.4% (23.9% by fuzzy match), label + body 84.5%, analysis 71.8% (re-run 25 Sep with the fixes of brief §27).
- **Against the typed witnesses** (`docs/witness-join.md`, `docs/witness-pndaza.md`): labels agree on 98.4% of 6,613 rows where both have one; analyses are ≥ 0.8 / < 0.4 similar in 83.0% / 1.1%. Pn Daza's page-referenced copy gives a typed text for 597 of the articles the OCR could not place.
- P. 815, unindexed, begins two entries with p. 816's unlocated headwords (a small misfiling). P. 727 (0 of 2) is shared stems.

## Spot check

One page, p. 476 (a page near the middle of the book with 9–14 headwords): 12 of 12; labels 12, all as the witness.
Checked in the text (each placed row opens on its headword, with its label) and against the typed witness page by page; the image was not opened.
For this batch the spot check is one page per book, not three: vols. 10–19 are checked page by page against the typed witness instead, and the three books without one (14/3, 20, 22) on the image.
